reasoning.step1:
1) Document classification
- Looked for invoice indicators: "Rechnung", "Gesamtbetrag", "USt", "Endbetrag", line items, amounts — present.
- No exclusion headers like "Mahnung" or "Zahlungserinnerung" — none prominent.
- Conclusion: document is an invoice; proceed to extract.

2) Identify sender VAT (Sender.VatId)
- Found "UID Nr. ATU          63118227" near sender block (Pötzelsberger ... Service GmbH).
- This matches sender tax ID. Do not confuse with customer USt.-ID-Nr. (ATU22642807) which is the buyer.
- Extract Sender.VatId = "ATU63118227" (keep original identifier letters and numbers; remove extra spaces).

3) Invoice date (Invoice.Date)
- Found "Datum: 23.12.2023" in header.
- Extract as string exactly "23.12.2023".

4) Grand total (GrandTotal.Amount)
- Found "Endbetrag 117,58 EUR" and also line showing 117,58 EUR for amounts due.
- Convert comma decimal to dot for numeric field -> 117.58.
- Extract GrandTotal.Amount = 117.58 (number).

5) VAT rate(s) (Vat.Rate)
- Found "USt 20,00%" and "zuzüglich USt 20,00% aus 97,98 19,60 EUR".
- VAT rate is 20 -> per rule, return without percent symbol as number -> 20.
- Extract Vat.Rate = 20.

6) Net amount(s) (Net.Amount)
- Found "Gesamtbetrag 97,98 EUR" and line "zuzüglich USt 20,00% aus 97,98 19,60 EUR" — net amount 97,98.
- Convert comma to dot -> 97.98 (number).
- Extract Net.Amount = 97.98.

7) VAT amount(s) (Vat.Amount)
- Found VAT amount "19,60 EUR" corresponding to 20% on 97,98.
- Convert comma to dot -> 19.60 (number).
- Extract Vat.Amount = 19.60.

8) Validate no inference, multiple occurrences
- All extracted values are explicitly present in invoice text.
- No other VAT groups or exchange rates applicable to entire invoice detected.
- Ensure requested schema fields will be filled accordingly; if multiple VAT items were required, would present as array entries, but here single group is present.
